---
title: "07 — Temporal winner/loser"
format: html
execute: {echo: false, warning: false, message: false}
---

## Purpose

Summarize the upstream winner/loser and temporal lineage, which is not changed by downstream exclusions.

## Inputs

Upstream AUC contrasts and significance-based winner/loser categories across time horizons.

## Decisions and exclusions

All upstream taxa are retained, including the six taxa excluded only from downstream resident modeling.

## Before/after counts and validation checks

```{r}
winner_loser <- targets::tar_read(winner_loser)
summary <- targets::tar_read(temporal_summary)
kappa <- targets::tar_read(temporal_kappa)
flow <- targets::tar_read(flow_validation)
knitr::kable(data.frame(winner_loser_rows = nrow(winner_loser)))
knitr::kable(summary$counts)
knitr::kable(kappa)
knitr::kable(flow)
```

## Problems flagged

Category-loss, inconsistent linked rows, or failed temporal flow checks stop rendering.

## Canonical outputs

`winner_loser`, `temporal_summary`, `temporal_kappa`, and temporal flow/transition targets.

## PASS/FAIL

Temporal conservation and category validations must pass before rendering.
